brief:
About 700,000 children across Gaza are returning to schooling, but most lack functioning school buildings after widespread destruction, IMEMC News reported. Classes are being held in makeshift settings including tents as the territory attempts to restart education despite the devastation.

The resumption marks an effort to restore some normalcy for Gaza's youth, though the scale of infrastructure damage means improvised learning spaces will likely persist. Teachers and students face significant challenges in continuing education amid the ongoing humanitarian crisis.
dek: About 700,000 children are expected to return to lessons across Gaza—but most have no school to return to.
title: Gaza children resume lessons in tents as schools lie in ruins
